description: Brand and content rules for AI-generated service cards. Single source of truth: used by the validator (app/rules.py) and by the MCP tool get_brand_rules.

banned_content.prices: No prices or amounts of money in any text field (e.g. $19, 19 $, 25 dollars).
banned_content.guarantees: No guarantees or absolute claims (e.g. guaranteed, 100%, best in town, risk-free).
banned_content.discounts: No discounts or promotions (e.g. 90% off, promo code, coupon, half price).

voice: Write for a busy visitor who decides in five seconds.
Never invent facts that are not in the business brief.
